platform.description: The CDS package to use for a specific platform. For a browser app this would be 'web' and for a React Native app this would be 'mobile'

tools.name: get-cds-doc
tools.description: get a specific cds doc route based on the routes available from list-routes

route.description: The route to the CDS docs. The path should always have a <platform>/<route> format and end in .txt
